description: Source code for LoRaWAN services implementation, including message scheduling, class C session management, and work queue handling.

methods.name: uplink_handler
methods.description: Handles scheduled uplink messages, sends them via lorawan_send, and reschedules the next message.

methods.name: insert_uplink
methods.description: Inserts a new uplink message into the priority queue based on its scheduled ticks.

methods.name: lorawan_services_init
methods.description: Initializes the LoRaWAN services, including message list, semaphore, work queue, and mutex.
